title: CSCI 344 — Programming Language Concepts
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a programming language specification, including syntax, semantics, and execution model.
Explain how lexical analysis, scoping, and data model behavior govern program execution and state management.
Apply structural verification and debugging methodologies to identify and resolve syntactic, runtime, and logical errors in code.
